content.html:
Makita is a well-known brand in the power tool industry, but did you know they also offer a robot vacuum?

In this review, we will be taking a closer look at the Makita robot vacuums and evaluating its features, specs, pros, and cons, along with our thoughts about the product.

Whether you're in the market for a new vacuum or just curious about Makita's offering, this article will provide you with the information you need to make an informed decision.

Makita Brief Brand Overview

Makita is a Japanese brand that was established in 1915 and is primarily known for its power tools and construction equipment. The company has a reputation for producing high-quality, durable products that are designed for professional use.

In addition to power tools, Makita also offers a range of outdoor power equipment and accessories. The company has recently expanded into the vacuum industry and now offers a robot vacuum.

The Makita Robot Vacuums were launched a few years back and are a relatively new addition to the company's product lineup.

Despite being a newcomer to the vacuum industry, Makita has a strong reputation for producing durable and reliable products, and the Robot Vacuum is no exception.

Benefits of Commercial Robot Vacuums

Time is money and is one of the most precious resources in the world. Every second that passes, will never be seen again! One of the main reasons why I love robot vacuums is because of the life-changing time savings you receive.

However, this is best achieved with robot vacs that are more on the hands-off autonomous side, which comes at a premium cost.

Makita Robot Vacuums are made to pick up very fine dust to large metal screws (2 inches long), and rocks with ease. This is huge! By keeping debris off the ground, it reduces tripping hazards and damage to motorized equipment. Also, using this robot vacuum in a commercial setting reduces labor costs and allows staff to focus on more important tasks. All this puts more money back in the business owner's pocket.

What Types Of Robot Vacuums do They Offer?

Makita mainly offers the following models of robot vacuums:

  1. Makita DRC200PT (Teal / Greenish-Blue Colored Model)

DRC200PT

  • Cleans approximately 5,380 square feet of hard floor surfaces using two 18V LXT 5.0Ah batteries BL1850B
  • Upto 200 minutes of continuous operation on hard floors in "main brush Plus vacuum" mode using two 18V LXT 5.0Ah batteries
Check Price on Amazon

Using only two 18V LXT 5.0Ah batteries, the Makita DRC200PT robot vacuum can clean an impressive 5,380 square feet of hard floor surfaces.

Its energy-efficient design and BL Brushless motor allow for continuous usage for up to 200 minutes. The three-stage cleaning process used by this vacuum ensures thorough results.

  1. Makita DRC300Z (White Colored Model)

DRC300Z

  • Innovative LiDAR sensor technology and front camera sensor help to map and save up to 5 rooms totaling over 100,000 square feet
  • Connects to a smartphone (with dedicated app installed) for smart cleaning
  • Obstacle detection with six ultrasonic sensors, one bumper sensor, and one
Check Price on Amazon

With its front camera and LiDAR sensors, the Makita DRC300Z, a high-tech robot vacuum, can map and record data from up to five rooms totaling more than 100,000 square feet.

To operate, just link it to your smartphone and use the accompanying app. This cleaner can identify obstacles with its ultrasonic, LiDAR, and bumper sensors.

One 18V LXT battery is required for operation, and a second battery may be added for longer use.

Which one to choose?

It's crucial to think about your needs and preferences in a robot vacuum before settling on one of these two models.

If you're on a budget, you can't go wrong with the Makita DRC200PT, but if you're willing to spend a little more, the Makita DRC300Z is a better choice because of its sophisticated mapping and other features.

What We Like About Makita Robot Vacuums:

We like the fact that this robotic vacuum has a big coverage area of 5000+ sq ft. This feature makes it a great fit for large workshops and commercial properties. It can also clean under furniture and even corners.

The HEPA filters in the Makita robot vacuum work well when removing dust, dirt, and debris from the air. You’ll love this feature as it reduces allergy symptoms for people who suffer from asthma or allergies.

The robot vacuum comes with advanced sensors that help it avoid obstacles in its path, such as furniture or pets. This feature will keep your home safe from any damage caused by the robot vacuum while cleaning.

We also like the use of LIDAR navigation technology in the robot vacuum, which allows it to map the area quite efficiently.

What We Don't Like About Makita Robot Vacuums:

The drawback at the surface level is their cost compared to other options in the market. Other premium level robot vacuums, such as Roborock and Ecovacs, offer self-cleaning and self-emptying capabilities at a similar price range.

However, there is an argument to be made that Makita's offers solid entry-level commercial robot vacuums that are well-priced versus other commercial solutions in the market. Other autonomous heavy-duty commercial robo vacs can cost tens of thousands of dollars to purchase.

Thus, unless you require a commercial-grade product with powerful cleaning capabilities for a large home or small commercial space, it may be considered an overinvestment.

However, if you have a need for an efficient, commercial-grade cleaning solution, Makita robot vacuums may be a suitable option.

Pros And Cons:

Features:

  • The 3-stage cleaning system ensures thorough cleaning of your space, leaving it dust and debris-free.
  • The large side and power brushes ensure that dirt and dust in every nook and cranny is cleaned, leaving your floor spotless.
  • With a long run time of up to 200 minutes, you can clean a large area without worrying about the battery running out.
  • The 5000+ square feet of coverage ensures that your entire hard floor surface is cleaned thoroughly.
  • The brushless motor is optimized to conserve battery usage, ensuring that the robot vacuum can run for a longer time without needing a recharge.
  • Two separate dust collecting chambers: Two separate dust collecting chambers allow for effective separation of debris based on its size, making it a great option for commercial use.
  • The laser-based LIDAR technology ensures efficient mapping and navigation, reducing cleaning time and ensuring that the robot vacuum covers all areas thoroughly.
  • Advanced sensors ensure that the robot vacuum avoids obstacles, preventing any damage and ensuring a safe cleaning experience.
  • The use of HEPA filters ensures that even the tiniest dust particles are captured, leaving your space clean and fresh.
  • With a dust collection capacity of almost 3 liters, you can clean a large area without worrying about frequent trips to empty the dustbin.
  • The commercial-grade construction makes the robot vacuum durable and suitable for tough usage, making it a great investment for commercial spaces.

Specifications:

What Comes In The Box?

With Greenish-Blue Makita Robot Vacuum Model, you get the following:

  • Batteries
  • Charger
  • Main Brush Roller
  • Main Brush Cover
  • HEPA Filter
  • Side-Brush Assembly
  • Wireless Remote Control

With the White – premium Makita Robot Vacuum model, you get the following:

  • Boundary Tape
  • Filter
  • Wireless remote control
  • Other tools (without battery and charger)

Final Verdict

In short, Makita is a reputable brand that is known for delivering high-quality and durable products, including its robot vacuum. With options for both homeowners and professionals, the robot vacuum is designed to meet the needs of different users.

If you are in the market for a commercial-grade vacuum cleaner, the Makita white model, equipped with HEPA filters and advanced laser-based navigation technology, is a great option.

However, if you have a more limited budget, the greenish-blue model is also powerful and provides excellent cleaning results for large areas.
